the influenza virus hemaglutinin (HA) used in subunit vaccine is a macromolecular complex that can have a variable number of subunits (6 to 8) and that the complexes can be in at least four different structural polymorphisms.
the structure of the HA complex in the subunit vaccine is not homogeneous and that there are multiple polymorphisms in the complex.
